text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
The day has finally arrived, my dear
Doto! Come,
we must make haste for the
Japanese Derby!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Huh, it's here already?! I haven't even debuted yet...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Huh? Oh my goooosh, I was so nervous!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She made the mistake of thinking she
was an
entrant. With things set straight,
the three of us
go to the race as
spectators.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Um, I have something to ask you two...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I heard this year's Derby is full of
human-eating
monsters.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Haaah ha ha! I can't vouch for the human-eating part, but they are known as the "Ultimate Generation."

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Have a look for yourself. There goes
Seiun Sky,
floating listless and
untethered as a cloud. And
here you'll
see King Halo, who touts herself as

first-rate wherever and whenever she
pleases.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Over there is Special Week, the pride of

Hokkaido with the airs of a ruler! Grass
Wonder
and El Condor Pasa also belong
to this
generation, but they are not with
us today.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
A true golden act their generation is!
Those
spangles finely set the stage for
my arrival come
next year!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Oh, oh, ohhh, wow... All five of them
sound so
strong!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After the ceremonial proceedings finish
at the
paddock, the race begins. And
then...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
T-T-Trainer... I just saw something...
amazing...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
This is the Derby... and that.. was Special
Week.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Special Week emerges the winner,
finishing with
an impressive lead of five
lengths.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The hair-raising competition between
the Golden
Generation has shaken
Fuchu, and no less has it
shaken Meisho
Doto.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Oh nonono! Wh-what if I was t-t-to run
in a race
like this?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: They would run laps over me! I have to do something—I need to do something.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Where should I start?! What about my
dash? I
could try swimming, or
weightlifting? Wait, what
about my
dash?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Aaahh, I've said dash twice now. Hwaah,
is this
part of an elaborate prank on
me?! Ohhh...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: COMPOSE YOURSELF!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
T.M. Opera O's dramatic voice echoes
throughout
the arena.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Is this all it takes to frighten you? Who
are you?
Do I have to remind you?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
You are Meisho Doto, the one who has
chosen to
proceed forth alongside me,
T.M. Opera O!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
The thousand-stair climb begins with
one step. If
misplaced, the future is no
more. Am I
misguided?!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Gasp?! You're r-right! Oh, Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
You're... right... It isn't like I'm suddenly
running in
the Derby tomorrow...
choice_data_list: まずはメイクデビュー頑張ろう

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I'll start small and work my way up. If
you and
Opera O are willing to support
me...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I'll do my best! I'll work really, really hard for my debut!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meisho Doto comes back to her senses,
gripping
her fists tightly with vigor. The
Derby has had
quite the positive effect
on her.
